posts.name: Arjun  K R
posts.cooked:
My specific doubt is on the topic: Python - OPPE 2 preparation

My doubt is: I scored low in OPPE 1 and need to score very high in the upcoming OPPE 2. Please guide me in my preparation, and kindly clarify whether the syllabus for OPPE 2 covers Week 1 to Week 8.

posts.name: Sujal Vilas Shende
posts.cooked: same condition here , if anyone who did good in oppes pls guide us

posts.name: BHAVEN
posts.cooked:
The syllabus for OPPE-2 is same as OPPE-1 but the only difference is that the last question would be of file handling instead of pattern printing. You have to score >=40 in anyone of the OPPEs to obtain a grade in the course. Practise the given sets of PYQs for the OPPE available on the portal to get a clear picture of the questions.

1000001097914×222 81 KB

Source: Grading Document

posts.name: omkar Shinde
posts.cooked:
I gave oppe in the previous term, Scored 100 in both OPPE. Learn python built in functions . There are many string class methods practice them well.
So you will not have to implement manually thus saving time and implementation error in exam.
Practice a lot of questions on platform like atcode r, codeforces and portal questions.skill to tackle unseen problem is the thing there are testing through exams.hope it helps.
You basically have to draw some observations and plan the steps to execute through python.
